purpose: Non-qualifying mechanism diagnosis of whether held-out kernel opportunity/support overlap explains residual heterogeneous-geometry TTF-C failure after immutable Q5, Q5.1, and Q5.2 endpoints. This rule defines no repair candidate and cannot qualify TTF-C.
diagnostic_question: Does cross-split kernel opportunity induce a common rank axis in held-out prediction and held-out turnover, creating private false transfer and/or shifted-geometry power loss specifically for TTF-C?

fixed_estimators.ttf_m: frozen Q5 heterogeneous estimator: raw mismatch turnover in train and held-out systems, prior mean 0.5
fixed_estimators.ttf_c: frozen Q5.1 estimator: training coupling turnover length-orthogonalized within system; held-out coupling turnover raw; ordinary held-out Spearman; prior mean 0.0

support_object.definition: For each held-out edge, evaluate the exact frozen training-kernel mass at the same five segment quadrature points used by TTF and average that mass over the edge. This response-blind quantity is called edge kernel opportunity.
support_object.prior_fraction: At each segment point prior_strength/(kernel_opportunity+prior_strength), averaged over the edge.

per_system_endpoints: opportunity_partial_score = rank correlation after projecting prediction rank and target rank off edge kernel-opportunity rank; diagnostic only
world_aggregate_endpoints: macro-average raw_score for TTF-M and TTF-C
macro-average opportunity_partial_score for TTF-M and TTF-C
macro-average opportunity_alignment_product for TTF-M and TTF-C

interpretation_tests.private_relation_opportunity_mediation: On DSO_PRIVATE_C worlds, bootstrap the world-level mean of raw_C - partial_C and the Spearman association across worlds between raw_C and alignment_C. Support requires lower95(raw_C-partial_C) > 0 and lower95(rho(raw_C,alignment_C)) > 0.
interpretation_tests.private_mismatch_opportunity_mediation: Apply the same two diagnostics on DSO_PRIVATE_M worlds; report without candidate selection.
interpretation_tests.shifted_power_support_loss: Compare DSO_POWER_M_SHIFTED with DSO_POWER_M_MATCHED for TTF-C. Support requires lower95(mean_prior_fraction_shifted - matched) > 0 AND upper95(raw_C_shifted - raw_C_matched) < 0.
interpretation_tests.estimand_specificity: Compare opportunity-mediation effect raw-partial between C and M on the same private worlds. Specificity requires lower95((raw_C-partial_C)-(raw_M-partial_M)) > 0 in at least one private role; otherwise do not call the mechanism TTF-C-specific.
interpretation_tests.shared_relation_negative_control: DSO_POWER_C_MATCHED and DSO_POWER_C_SHIFTED are negative controls for generic collapse: report raw and partial C scores but impose no repair gate.

terminal_rule.if_supported: Freeze only the support-overlap diagnosis. Any corrective estimator must be defined later in a newly named prospective development family with fresh worlds.
terminal_rule.if_not_supported: Freeze the negative diagnosis and do not tune opportunity controls on these worlds. A different newly named mechanism diagnosis would be required.
